items.text:
Hi Claude, I have an opportunity to take my career to the next level. As you know with my Cutting Edge project in Cowork, I work in the aerospace and defense industry. My company has been building a compliance and proposal writing, coaching AI system (in OpenAI). They've been dealing with a lot of hallucinations, errors, etc. 

I've prided myself in learning with Claude, and building process operational excellence through the Gauntlet protocol, skills I've implemented to you, and with how much we've refined the Fantasy Basketball tool. 

I'd like you to write for me a standardized, "rules of engagement", such as the Gauntlet protocol order of operations, the agreements and handshakes that the Fantasy Basketball tool follows (again, standardized, not specifically for basketball).

Can you write these for me to showcase my AI operational process to my CEO? This could fundamentally change the trajectory of my career - and with the hopes - implement these principles, skills to  our company AI system (and hopefully even convince to transition to Claude) as my job primary role.

Please ask clarifying questions so that we can create an impressive resume and showcase of operational AI excellence that I've built alongside you in our journey.
